newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese navy patrol fires on Spanish trawler.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese navy patrol fires on Spanish trawler.

text.p: A Portuguese navy patrol boat fired three warning shots while chasing a Spanish trawler found fishing illegally off Portugal's southern coast but no one was hurt, a Portuguese navy spokesman said on Thursday.
Commander Carlos Brites Nunes told TSF radio the patrol boat fired after the trawler had tried to ram it near the port of Vila Real de Santo Antonio on Wednesday morning.
"We regret that there has been another incident and we stress that Portuguese sovereignty and fishing resources are at stake," the navy spokesman said.
Last September two Spanish fishermen were injured when a Portuguese patrol boat fired warning shots in a similar incident, sparking a formal protest from Madrid.
